I-- I just wanted to say that I was thinking about you and the kids, and, uh...
I-- I just wanted to say that I was thinking about you and the kids, and, uh...
You shouldn't have let me sleep.
Skyler, I don't entirely remember what happened last night.
I said something-- Did you know this Gale Boetticher person?
Skyler, I can't even focus. I don't-- Gale Boetticher.
What exactly did I say last night?
Was it the people you work for?
At some point... might want to do the same to you?
I think I know what happened last night, Walt.
Mm. I know exactly what happened last night.
You told Hank that the man he was looking for might still be out there, that it might not be this-- Mm.
And I was up all night wondering why you would say that to him.
No, but then-- But then I was remembering your black eye-- Your, uh, business disagreement that you don't want to talk about.
I don't want to talk about any of this ever.
That's how we need to approach this thing.
And then I remembered the message you left me the other day...
when you said you loved me.
When I heard that, I thought that maybe... you-- I don't know-- That you were regretting what's happened between us, and I get that.
I think that message was some... kind of goodbye.
I think last night was a cry for help.
I think some part of you wants Hank to catch you.
That is just-- That is-- That is it.
You're like Dr. Joyce Brothers here.
If he caught you, at least this would all be over.
Oh, yeah. That's a tremendous weight just lifted off of me.
If you are in danger, we go to the police.
Oh, no. I don't want to hear about the police.
I do not say that lightly.
I know what it could do to this family.
But if it's the only real choice we have-- If it's either that-- Oh... or your getting shot when you open your front door-- I don't want to hear about the police.
You're not some hardened criminal, Walt.
That's what we tell them. That's the truth.
A schoolteacher, cancer, desperate for money?
Roped into working for-- Unable to even quit?
You told me that yourself, Walt.
Let's both of us stop trying to justify this whole thing and admit you're in danger.
Who are you talking to right now?
Who is it you think you see?
Do you know how much I make a year?
I mean, even if I told you, you wouldn't believe it.
Do you know what would happen if I suddenly decided to stop going in to work?
A business big enough that it could be listed on the NASDAQ goes belly-up, disappears.
It ceases to exist without me. No.
You clearly don't know who you're talking to, so let me clue you in.
I am not in danger, Skyler.
A guy opens his door and gets shot, and you think that of me?
I am the one who knocks.
And where is your pretty wife?
She has other business to attend to.
Well, like I say to her, place is as is. Understand?
I don't want her coming back with more demands.
She-- She gave me hard time when we settled on price.
We're all on the same page, Bogdan.
So you are the boss now, huh?
I know you think I was hard on you, but you'll learn.
Being in charge is not easy.
You've seen me work hard, Bogdan.
But maybe, when you are the boss, uh, you will just keep your feet up and relax.
The real important thing, and not everyone knows this is, is to be tough.
A boss has to be tough.
Has to say no to people.
Has to make cashiers wipe down cars, even if they don't want to.
I-- I'm sure you can handle.
And if not, you can always call your wife, huh?
Who'd have thought that someday I would be handing these keys to you?
You want me to call her back?
But what exactly did she say?
Just, you know, she asked if I was okay and not to worry.
Any, uh, rough timetable on this thing, or as to when she's coming home?
Uh, it's-- It's about the gambling, right?
Well, it's-- It's kind of hard to-- She-- She can't understand.
It-- It-- It's not like you're doing this on purpose.
It-- It's like you're an alcoholic, right?
No, it's not. Not at all.
Yes, it is. I read online.
She's not even allowed to be mad at you, and she can't be mad at you about the cancer, can she?
No, son, these are two very different things.
Not really. Gambling addiction is a sickness.
What is going on with me is not about some disease.
It's about choices-- Choices that I have made, choices I stand by.
You're not moving back in, are you?
Why don't we take a little detour?
I think it's time we got you your own car.
I-- I think if you're going to buy me off... buy me off.
I-- I do, Thank you, Dad.
All right, I need an update.
An update on these little field trips that you've been taking with Mike.
I told you already. We pick up money, check on things, stuff like that.
But what? That's what you said.
I said I guarded him, like backup, like a second set of eyes.
And this has to be you.
It can't be... I don't know.
Tyrus or any of those couple dozen muscle heads that Gus has working for him?
It has to be Jesse Pinkman.
What is there, something about you that I don't know?
Are you a former Navy SEAL?
Do you have to have your hands registered as lethal weapons?
All I'm saying is that do you not even question this?
Do you really believe that you mean anything to these people?
And I'm not trying to be insulting.
I'm just trying to make you see things clearly.
I see they can't outright kill me, but they don't want me getting high.
I see this thing probably started as Gus getting Mike to babysit me.
I saved Mike from getting robbed, even killed, maybe.
So maybe I'm not such a loser after all.
I mean, what if it-- Oh, God.
I mean, what if-- What if it's all just a setup?
What? - What if this robbery that you stopped wasn't even real?
Your first day out guarding Mike.
He steps out for one second, and what happens?
Keep your friends close, keep your enemies closer.
Like you said, Gus can't kill you because of me.
He knows I won't stand for it.
He needs me, and he hates the fact that he needs me, so what does he do? He goes to work driving a wedge between you and me.
If you'd been there, you'd know it wasn't a setup.
Wait a minute. How long did those guys chase you?
Huh? Because the way you describe it, they gave up pretty damn easy.
No, no. This-- This whole thing, all of this--
Uh, who is it? Hang on.
Well, am I supposed to clean all this on my own?
Buenos días. Uh, do you speak English?
No. Okay, uh... yo-- Yo, uh-- Help, help-- Uh, ayon-- Ayonda-- Ayuda. Ayuda, ayuda. Gracias, gracias.
Uh, yo necesita-- Necesito ayuda a limpio.
Uh... Uh, por favor, por favor.
No, no, no, no. No podemos.
No, no, no, no. Es no problema.
Un momento, un momento, un momento.
Yo necesito ayuda, uh... limpio dos horas máximo.
Let me see. Let me see. Un momento.
I'll tell you what. I'll tell you what.
There's one for you. Yes, sí.
And más dinero-- Más dinero after--
I think we listened to you.
Uh, the deal is we're watching that house.
A couple down on the left with the tree in the front.
A little birdie told me there's some guys in there that have 3 pounds of our product which they're selling and which they sure as hell didn't get from us.
We sit here and watch that house until one of our entrepreneurs pops his head out.
Then we ask a few questions and get our property back.
Why don't you just go break the door down and pistol whip those bitches and show them who's boss?
Because a little birdie also told me these guys are heavily into the product and most likely armed.
Now, what you may not know about meth heads-- Maybe you do-- They're kind of unpredictable.
I don't care for unpredictable, so we wait.
Sorry to burst your bubble, kid, but that's 90% of the job.
Uh... pimiento cheese. How does that sound?
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Where are you going?
Tucker! Will you shut the damn door?
Thought you maybe had some of the blue?
Tucker, will you shut the damn door?
Tucker, will you shut the door?
Guess we'll go with Plan A, then.
There's something in there I need.
I'm getting those pricks out of that house.
Oh, your first attempt being such a wild success.
You may know this whole P.I. sit-in-the-car business, but I know meth heads.
How deep do you think it is?
Hey, uh... you mind taking over for a minute?
Hey, uh, mind if I use your john?
Hey, I'm, uh-- I'm a friend of Tucker's.
I just, uh-- Just want to-- Just want to buy some of the blue.
Well, I know you were selling it earlier, so-- Yeah? How do you know that?
Yeah, well, Tucker needs to learn to keep his damn mouth shut.
So, uh... you going to help me out?
Don't have enough for all of Tucker's asshole friends.
Yo, I-- I think he's outside.
Why don't you just-- Why don't you go outside-- Tucker! Tucker!
Hey, hey. Let's go-- Let's go find Tucker.
Okay? Let's go outside and-- I don't have enough for you, all right?
I don't want to-- I don't want to start any trouble.
No, no. I'm just saying we're cool, okay?
What-- Don't put thoughts in my head!
You don't put thoughts in my head!
I missed that one. I'm sure it was good.
Uh, what-- Wait a minute. Where are you taking them?
Come on, Tyrus, what are you doing?
I'm putting them on a bus.
One that takes them back to Honduras.
Hey, wait a second. Wait a minute.
You tell Gus to blame me, not them.
Give us a minute, will you?
The crew that hit our truck gave away the cargo to a couple of local nobodies.
Very disciplined, though, not keeping anything for themselves.
It was all about sending a message, which they did, literally.
It was written on the bucket lid.
That, I believe, is the English translation.
I know you're not really asking for advice, but let me hire 10, 15 more good operators, and we hit them back, hit them hard, hit them where they live.
This war stays cold for now.
What about their message? What's the answer?
Let's see what they have to say.
I hear you can handle yourself.
I like to think I see things in people.
Slow down. The car is not going anywhere.
Did you see what's in the driveway?
Yeah. Dad got it for me.
That was very nice of him.
I-- I know it looks like... well, awesome, but it's super safe.
And I promise to always go the speed limit or below, way below.
And it gets great gas mileage.
So Dad said I can take it around the block a few times.
I-It-- It's really-- It's really great to have you home, Mom.
Oh, I think you said plenty the other day.
No. Look, about that, it just-- Did you get the car wash keys?
Skyler, I may have... overstated things earlier, and I'm sorry to be so forward.
But I-- I just-- I want you to know something.
I want you to-- I need you to understand that you are safe.
You, Junior, Holly-- You are completely safe.
Everything that I do-- Everything-- I do it to protect this family.
So buying that car, that was protecting your family?
Okay. I, uh-- All right, maybe it's a little flashy, but he needed a car, and--
And I'm his father, and I should be able to get what he wants.
That car directly contradicts our story.
And if you're so invested in protecting this family, it means protecting the story.
What do you think the neighbors are going to say, Walt?
I was thinking that I wanted to do something nice for my son.
I just worry that he'll blame you for this.
Once again, he'll blame his bitch mother for taking away what his loving father has given him, so thanks for that.
Someone has to protect this family from the man who protects this family.
